description: This source file defines the IGrainTimer interface, which represents a timer associated with a grain in Orleans. It includes a method to change the timer's start time and interval, with detailed documentation on parameters and exceptions.

classes.name: IGrainTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a timer for Orleans grains, capable of being disposed and modifying timer schedule.

methods.name: Change
methods.description: Updates the start time and interval of the timer using TimeSpan values, with support for infinite delay or immediate restart.
